stories.headline: Oportun Deploys AI to Help Consumers Save for Recurring Expenses
stories.body: Oportun has expanded its savings app, Set & Save, to include a new artificial intelligence-powered feature that identifies routine bills and automatically helps members save toward upcoming payments. stories.headline: RIAs lose 5% of AUM a year. Here's how to win it back
stories.body: Research from Cerulli Associates indicates that marketing and referrals are the best ways to bring in new clients. Yet few firms devote much time or money to either.
